project: Property Abundance — cash home buying ad
generation_plan: Three separate generations of 10 seconds each. Generate CLIP_1, then CLIP_2, then CLIP_3. Paste one clip object per request, or the whole file if the tool accepts it.

READ_THIS_FIRST.numbers_rule: Every number in this file is metadata for the generator. NO number, digit, measurement, label or unit may ever appear inside the picture.
READ_THIS_FIRST.text_rule: Nothing in this file may be rendered as visible text. Do not draw prompt words onto paper, walls, signs or the ground.
READ_THIS_FIRST.duplication_rule: Each spoken line in spoken_lines_manifest is said exactly ONCE across the whole ad. Never repeat a line in another clip. Never restart a line that a previous clip began.
READ_THIS_FIRST.character_sheet_rule: If a character reference sheet or reference images are supplied alongside this prompt, those images are authoritative for the face. This file governs wardrobe, action, framing and speech.

style_lock.render_style: non-photorealistic stylized 3D animation, like a modern animated feature film
stylization_anchors: matte painted surfaces with no glossy specular highlights
simplified facial geometry, clean rounded forms
slightly stylized proportions, head marginally larger than real-world scale
soft ambient occlusion instead of physically accurate shadowing
flat clean skin shading with no pore or blemish detail
hair as a single sculpted shape, not individual strands
cloth as smooth simplified folds, not simulated fabric weave
must_not_look_like: realistic skin pores, wrinkles, stubble detail or subsurface scattering
photographic depth of field or lens grain
style_lock.drift_guard: If any frame starts to read as a real human or as live action, push further toward the animated feature look. Stylized always wins over realistic.
style_lock.palette: muted cream, warm grey, soft navy
style_lock.lighting: warm late-morning daylight from the upper left, soft and even
style_lock.camera_movement: every shot is locked off. No push in, no pull out, no zoom, no dolly, no handheld drift, anywhere in the ad.

character_lock.count_in_frame: exactly one person in every shot
character_lock.identity: one man, Black American, early forties, medium-brown skin, close-cropped hair, short trimmed beard with a few greys at the chin
character_lock.manner: calm, direct, unhurried. An ordinary neighbour, not a salesman, not a model, not a hype marketer.
character_lock.wardrobe: navy henley shirt, sleeves pushed up below the elbow, no logo, no collar, no buttons visible at the cuff, and mid-grey trousers
character_lock.wardrobe_lock: He wears the identical navy henley and mid-grey trousers in every shot of every clip. No polo shirt, no white shirt, no jacket, no tie, no suit, no change of clothing at any point.
character_lock.role_lock: He is the buyer-side host who explains what the company does. He is NEVER presented as a past customer, a seller, or someone giving a testimonial.
character_lock.hands: five fingers on every hand, always

location_lock.exterior: one ordinary American residential street in late morning. A single-storey cream house set well back behind a mown front lawn, a bare young tree at frame left, a concrete sidewalk running past.
location_lock.exterior_lock: The same street, the same house and the same light in every exterior shot across all three clips.
location_lock.interior: a plain kitchen with a light-oak table, daylight from an unseen window at the left, one plain cream mug on the table, plain cream wall behind. The table top is otherwise completely bare.

global_negative: no written text of any kind anywhere in the picture
no numbers, digits, prices, percentages or currency symbols
no measurements, dimension labels, arrows or diagram markings
no letters, words, handwriting, printing or signatures
no captions, subtitles, titles or lower thirds
no logos, brand marks or watermarks

spoken_lines_manifest.note: Eight lines. Each is spoken exactly once in the whole ad. Check this list against the generated audio before assembling.

lines.text: Ask us three questions. If we dodge one, walk.
Whose money is it? Ours, in writing.
Who closes it? Us. Never a stranger.
How did you get that number? We'll show every line.
Most buyers won't. That's the point.
We take the house as it stands.
Start with the questions. The offer comes after.
